paper_title: Getting More Out of Black Hole Superradiance: a Statistically Rigorous Approach to Ultralight Boson Constraints from Black Hole Spin Measurements
coupling_convention: pairs are [f_a in GeV, m_a in eV]; f_a computed from the paper's QCD axion relation mu = 5.691 neV * (1e15 GeV / f)
notes: Paper derives Bayesian black-hole superradiance constraints on ultralight boson mass mu and self-coupling f^-1 from spin measurements of M33 X-7 (tau_BH=3 Myr) and, for the first time, the SMBH IRAS 09149-6206 (tau_BH=450 Myr). Main results are 2D 95% credible exclusion regions in the (mu, f^-1) plane (Fig. 4), whose contours are not tabulated numerically in the text. The only explicit numerical exclusion is along the QCD axion line: 0.6 peV < mu < 3 peV excluded at 95% CI (M33 X-7, both equilibrium and bosenova scenarios; lower end set by the prior f < M_Planck). Emitted points trace this QCD-axion-line exclusion on the f_a-m_a plane. IRAS 09149-6206 additionally probes mu ~ 3e-19 eV region but no explicit numerical bounds are quoted. Not a DM haloscope; no local DM density assumption.
